reviews.author: Anna-riitta
reviews.positive:
Review of Acanto Loft – 6‑Week Stay
We stayed for six weeks in the Acanto Loft apartment and overall had a pleasant experience. The location is excellent – just a short walk from shops and essential services. The building itself is quiet, as are the neighbours. Some noise from the nearby road could be heard even with the windows closed, but nighttime traffic was minimal and did not disturb our sleep.
For a longer stay, the apartment’s equipment had a few shortcomings. Cleaning, as well as changing of bed linen and towels, was provided every two weeks, but no extra towels or sheets were available. There was a washing machine but no dryer, so laundry dried slowly in the humid climate.
The bedroom had one large bed with a single large duvet for two people. During the first week we struggled with sharing it, but after requesting an additional duvet, we received one quickly.
The apartment lacked some basic cleaning supplies, such as a vacuum cleaner, all‑purpose cleaner, dishwasher tablets, a dish brush, a cleaning cloth, a bathroom squeegee, and microfiber cloths. Toilet paper was replenished during cleaning, but kitchen paper was not. After requesting a vacuum cleaner and cleaning solution, we received them promptly. These missing items are inexpensive, and considering the relatively high rent for a six‑week stay, it would have been reasonable for them to be included from the beginning.
The customer service team was friendly and responded quickly to all our inquiries. Despite the minor shortcomings, we enjoyed our stay — largely thanks to the helpful and welcoming customer service.

reviews.author: Pamela
reviews.title: A lovely apartment in a great location.
reviews.positive:
The apartment was in an excellent location in the heart of Fuchal town and above the main shopping centre which has a huge supermarket where you can get everything that you need for self catering. It is very quiet as it looks out on a side street and there are good views up to the fort from the balcony.
Getting in to the apartment was easy as we were sent a short video showing us what to do. The apartment building is kept very clean and there are lifts. The apartment itself was excellent with a well-equipped kitchen, large lounge with comfortable sofa and a large dining table, a very comfortable bedroom with loads of wardrobe space and a great bathroom with large walk-in shower. There was also a balcony, as mentioned earlier. We had a problem with the toilet seat which seemed to be broken when we arrived, but there was someone out to fix it within an hour of reporting it. I would definitely recommend staying here.
reviews.negative:
I do think that 2 rolls of toilet paper for two people for a week is very mean. It would have only cost pence to provide more. The same goes for dishwasher tablets. If there is a dishwasher it seems only sensible to provide the tablets. I asked about this and they quickly brought me a handful of tablets but said that they didn't normally supply them. Previous occupants had obviously made do with washing up by hand, as I could see from the state of the wine glasses. Both these items cost very little, but make a big difference. 
This apartment wasn't cheap, so please don't be so mean in future.

GuestReady Team

En we vonden t best wel vol op een paar vierkante meter met 5 personen, ookal is t slim ingericht. De verschillende ruimtes zijn best klein. reviews.author: Katharina
reviews.title: Gemütliches Haus mit Dachterrasse
reviews.positive:
Das Haus ist sauber, gut eingerichtet und die Zimmeraufteilung ist sehr praktisch. Im Erdgeschoss befinden sich neben Küche und großzügigem Aufenthaltsbereich zwei Schlafzimmer mit je einem Doppelbett und ein kleines Badezimmer. Eine schmale Treppe führt nach oben, wo sich ein kleiner Stauraum, ein drittes Schlafzimmer mit Etagenbett und ein großes Badezimmer mit einer sehr guten Dusche befinden. Die Matratzen sind sehr gut, eher fest. Den traumhaften Ausblick aufs Meer und Landschaft bekommt man nur von der langen, schmalen Terrasse, die von außen über eine hohe Metalltreppe zu erreichen ist. Aus dem Haus selbst kann man nicht viel von der Schönheit der Umgebung sehen. 
Zu betonen wäre, dass diese Unterkunft nicht geeignet ist für Menschen mit schlechter körperlicher Kondition, die ohne Auto unterwegs sind: Der 10 - 15-minütige Fußweg vom Strand zum Haus ist anstrengend (je nach Fitness).
reviews.negative: Auf der Terrasse standen zwar genug Stühle, doch fehlte uns ein kleiner Tisch und Sonnenliegen. Das ist nur eine Anregung zur Verbesserung des Wohlbefindens.

Thank you so much for the perfect 10 out of 10! We are so happy to hear that you found the apartment clean, comfortable, and fully equipped for your needs. It is great to know that the spacious rooms and all the kitchen accessories made your stay feel a bit more like home.

It was truly a pleasure hosting you, and we would be absolutely delighted to welcome you back for another stay with us here on Madeira Island.

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: Amazing stay.
reviews.positive: Great apartment and hostility, would recommend without hesitation!
reviews.response:
Dear Anna.

Thank you so much for the perfect 10/10 rating and for taking the time to leave such wonderful feedback! We are thrilled to hear that you had an amazing stay and loved the apartment. Your kind words about our hospitality truly mean a lot to us.

It was an absolute pleasure hosting you, and we would be delighted to welcome you back to Madeira anytime you wish to return.

Warm regards.
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Bela
reviews.title: Clean, bright, well-kept and modern property!!
reviews.positive: Excellent location. Close to grocery stores, restaurants, water, easily walkable. Clean, modern, well-kept, looked like pictures 100%, good availability of pots and pans and dishes. Staff were great - kind, friendly, responsive to my texts.
reviews.negative: Bed was a little too firm for our liking and sofa bed is uncomfortable. Also it would be helpful to have some instructions on the pullout sofa bed and laundry machine.
reviews.response:
Dear Bela.

Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback!

We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the property’s location and made the most of both the nearby amenities and those provided within the apartment. It is also great to know that the apartment met your expectations in terms of cleanliness and upkeep.

Maintaining smooth and clear communication with our guests is a priority for us, as we strive to ensure a stress-free stay, so we are pleased to know we were able to maintain with you most of the time.

Regarding the mattress, we understand that comfort is subjective and can vary from person to person. As for the washing machine instructions, they are always available in the apartment, just like those for all other appliances. If we had known you planned to use the sofa bed, we would have been more than happy to assist you, just as we would with the washing machine.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and we hope to welcome you again in the near future!

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: excelente ... com muita praticidade
reviews.positive: A localização e estacionamento do prédio são os pontos de destaque. O apto está muito bem equipado, tudo muito limpo, o atendimento remoto via WhatsApp é muito rápido e pratico... Esta localizado perto de restaurantes, padarias, super mercados e dos principais pontos turísticos do centro histórico.
reviews.response:
Cara Andrea,  

Obrigado por partilhar o seu feedback incrível connosco!  
Ficamos muito felizes em saber que gostou da limpeza e das comodidades do apartamento, bem como da localização conveniente e do estacionamento privado disponível. A fantástica localização perto de restaurantes, cafés, supermercados e atrações turísticas é um dos destaques desta propriedade, e ficamos satisfeitos por saber que aproveitou ao máximo.  

Manter uma comunicação clara e eficaz com os nossos hóspedes é uma prioridade para nós, pois nos esforçamos para garantir uma estadia sem stress, por isso, é ótimo saber que esta foi a sua experiência.  

Agradecemos imenso as suas amáveis palavras e esperamos recebê-la novamente em breve!  

Os melhores votos,  
Equipa Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Agnieszka
reviews.positive: Świetne miejsce na nocleg w Funchal. Apartament niedawno oddany do użytku, czysty, zadbany, świetnie wyposażony. Parking podziemny to niewątpliwa zaleta w takiej lokalizacji. Przy kolejnej wizycie niewątpliwie wybrałabym to samo miejsce.
reviews.response:
Dear Agnieszka.

Thank you for sharing your positive experience with us. We’re pleased to read that the apartment’s cleanliness, maintenance, and underground parking were to your satisfaction. It will be our pleasure to welcome you back on your next trip to Funchal, and we look forward to hosting you again soon.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Justyna
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment:
I loved everything about this apartment. It had everything we needed for almost a week-long stay: a well-equipped kitchen, large wardrobe, comfy bed, and a sofa perfect for working. Big plus for the coffee machine with capsules, spices, and olive oil available for guests.
Location is fantastic—everything nearby, including two big supermarkets just steps away, yet quiet at night. Parking spot included (a bit tight, so opt for a smaller car).
Loved the welcome pack with fresh fruit and local treats.
reviews.response:
Dear Justyna.
Thank you so much for the fantastic 5-star review! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that you loved everything about the apartment and that it had all you needed for your stay. It is wonderful to know that you appreciated the fully equipped kitchen, the comfortable setup for working, and the welcome pack with fresh fruit and local treats!
We are also really glad that you enjoyed the fantastic, quiet location right next to the supermarkets. You are completely right about the parking space—while an SUV can fit, we always agree that a smaller car is definitely the ideal choice for easier maneuvering!
It was a true pleasure hosting you, and we would be absolutely delighted to welcome you back to Madeira anytime.
Warm regards.
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Alo
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Very clean and quiet place, everything is very nearby.
reviews.response:
Dear Alo.
Thank you for your kind feedback. We are delighted to know that you found the property clean, quiet, and conveniently located.
It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would be happy to welcome you back on a future visit.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Otto
reviews.title: Een heerlijk comfortabel huis op een geweldig eiland.
reviews.positive: Doordat we prachtig weer hadden hebben we de meeste tijd doorgebracht rond het zwembad en in de buitenkeuken. Een geweldige ruimte om te relaxen, te barbecueën en te eten. Door de enorme schuifpuien een echt buitengevoel en als het ‘s avonds toch wat afkoelt of gaat waaien kun je gemakkelijk wat meer beschutting creëren.
reviews.negative: De verlichting is vrij fel en koel en niet dimbaar. Om het gezellig te houden hebben we waxinelichtjes aangezet en ook wat nachtlampjes in de buitenkeuken gezet.

reviews.author: Roelof
reviews.positive: Ligging en rust en de uitrusting in het huis, en zwembad
reviews.negative: Niet echt schoon

reviews.author: Inna
reviews.title: Однозначно рекомендую!
reviews.positive:
Шикарна вілла у тихому районі містечка Кальєта. Мушу сказати, що це одне з найкомфортніших та найзатишніших помешкань в яких я коли-небудь бувала. 
Продумано все до деталей.
Вілла розрахована на велику компанію, кухні є аж три: гостьова, робоча та в барбекю зоні. Кохане приладдя є все необхідне і навіть більше.
reviews.response:
Dear Inna,

We are so pleased to read your kind review. It makes us happy to know that you found our villa not only luxurious but also one of the most comfortable and cozy places you’ve experienced. We put a lot of thought into the design and amenities, so it’s gratifying to hear that the three kitchens and the well-appointed accessories made such a positive impression.

Thank you for choosing our villa for your stay in Calheta. We would be delighted to welcome you back anytime you wish to return.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Stéphane
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Très belle maison, fonctionnelle et très bien équipé, piscine magnifique. Echanges fluides et efficace avec Atlantic Holiday du début  à la fin du séjour. Je recommande!

reviews.author: Konstantin
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
Beautiful villa. Great view over the ocean. Nice pool. Had everything we needed to cook and bbq.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Bandar
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment:
The worst part and a spoiler was to wait for cleaners to finish well after the checking in time of 4.0pm. 
They left after 5.0pm
I consider that to be very disrespectful and unprofessional.
reviews.response:
Dear Bandar.
We would like to clarify your review, as it does not accurately reflect what happened.
You attempted to access the property well before the official check-in time and without our authorisation. When you later returned to the property, at approximately 17h00 the cleaning team was already leaving with their vehicle. Therefore, it is not accurate to state that you had to wait for the cleaning team to finish, as you attempted to enter the property before the official check-in time.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Iulian
reviews.positive: Great location, good value for the money, unique property.
reviews.response:
Dear Iulian,

We appreciate you taking the time to leave your review. It is great to know that the property suited your stay and that you enjoyed staying with us. We would be happy to host you again on a future visit.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Karolina
reviews.title: Convenient, but check location on the map - power station next door
reviews.positive: It was located close to the Camara de Lobos town (about 10-15minutes walk), which was convenient for pedestrian use. Nice, good-enough equipped kitchen. Two bedrooms, one with very little light, comfortable for rest.
reviews.negative:
There is a power station next door that makes LOUD humming noise 24/7. Very much worth noticing.
There were roadworks on the way in, fairly difficult location to get to with a car. Certainly difficult for a driver that does not drive a manual transmission car (driver needs to back into a garage from a narrow slanted one-way street).
Additional town tax included that is not explained/included in the pricing. EUR2 per adult person per day. Another company is managing this property, so it adds a layer to communication...

reviews.author: Irina
reviews.positive:
The house is absolutely lovely and very well-equipped with everything needed for a week-long stay. The interior is beautiful and very comfortable.

​However, I feel it is important to mention for future guests that there is a factory nearby that operates 24/7. The noise is constant and quite loud, which makes it impossible to enjoy the balcony. More importantly, it was very difficult for me to fall asleep at night due to the noise, which significantly affected the quality of my rest.

​Overall, the house itself is great, but please consider the noise factor if you are a light sleeper or looking for absolute quiet."
